title: What Wall Street's latest targets reveal: Hut 8 +155%, Opera +90%,even Disney +15%. Which of these targets is actually realistic?
author: tickeron_community
selftext:
Analysts are still swinging big. Hut 8's average target of $135 sits  
about 155% above its \~$53 price, Opera's $27 is about 90% above  
$14.17, and Amer Sports' $48 implies about 59%. Even Disney and Home  
Depot get about 15%. Targets, not promises, so see what has to go  
right.  
  
Here is the rundown, drawn from today's write-ups.  
  
\*\*1. Hut 8 Corp (HUT)\*\* — The central price target of $135 is the  
arithmetic mean of roughly 19 verified analyst price targets reviewed  
for this article, with an unusually wide range from $75 to $245. At a  
recent price near $53, reaching $135 would require a gain of roughly  
155%, a very large move even by the standards of a volatile  
crypto-adjacent stock. Target, not a promise.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/hut-8-corp-hut-can-it-reach-the-135-analyst-target-for-155-gains-39917/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/hut-8-corp-hut-can-it-reach-the-135-analyst-target-for-155-gains-39917/)  
  
\*\*2. Opera (OPRA)\*\* — The central target of $27 is the arithmetic mean  
of six verified analyst price targets, which range from a low of $23  
to a high of $33. With the stock near $14.17, reaching $27 would  
require roughly a 90% advance — a very large move relative to the  
current price. Target, not a promise.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/opera-limited-opra-can-it-achieve-a-90-rally-to-the-27-target-40043/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/opera-limited-opra-can-it-achieve-a-90-rally-to-the-27-target-40043/)  
  
\*\*3. Quantinuum (QNT)\*\* — The central price target of $60 is the  
arithmetic mean of 11 recent, individually attributable analyst price  
targets, rounded from a calculated average of about $60.60. The  
verified analyst target range spans roughly $50 to $80, reflecting  
unusually wide disagreement about how fast quantum computing can be  
commercialized. Target, not a promise.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/quantinuum-qnt-analyst-targets-signal-potential-78-upside-39976/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/quantinuum-qnt-analyst-targets-signal-potential-78-upside-39976/)  
  
\*\*4. Amer Sports (AS)\*\* — The central target of $48 is the arithmetic  
mean of 16 verified analyst price targets reviewed, ranging from  
roughly $38 to $62. With the stock trading around $30, reaching $48  
implies an upside of roughly 59% — a very large move from current  
levels. Target, not a promise.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/amer-sports-as-weighing-the-path-to-48-and-59-upside-40006/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/amer-sports-as-weighing-the-path-to-48-and-59-upside-40006/)  
  
\*\*5. SQM (SQM)\*\* — The central $80 stock price target is the  
arithmetic mean of roughly 18 current analyst 12-month price targets  
(about $78.50, reported via S&P Global), rounded to a clean level. The  
latest verified price is about $51.66 , meaning a move to $80 requires  
roughly 55% upside — a substantial move, not a marginal one. Target,  
not a promise.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/sqm-stock-analyst-targets-center-on-80-with-55-upside-potential-40009/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/sqm-stock-analyst-targets-center-on-80-with-55-upside-potential-40009/)  
  
\*\*6. Kanzhun (BZ)\*\* — The central target examined here is $20 ,  
calculated as the rounded average of verified, current analyst price  
targets on Kanzhun Limited (BZ) , the Beijing-based operator of the  
BOSS Zhipin recruitment platform. With the latest verified price near  
$13.09 , reaching $20 would require a rise of roughly 53% , a very  
large move relative to the current level. Target, not a promise.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/kanzhun-bz-analyst-target-of-20-points-to-53-upside-potential-40014/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/kanzhun-bz-analyst-target-of-20-points-to-53-upside-potential-40014/)  
  
\*\*7. [JD.com](http://JD.com) (JD)\*\* — The $36 central target is the arithmetic mean of  
13 recent, attributed analyst price targets, with a wide range of  
roughly $23 to $47. At $25.43, reaching $36 would require a gain of  
about 42%, a substantial move from current levels. Target, not a  
promise.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/jd-com-jd-assessing-the-road-to-a-36-target-and-42-upside-40000/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/jd-com-jd-assessing-the-road-to-a-36-target-and-42-upside-40000/)  
  
\*\*8. Klarna (KLAR)\*\* — The central $19 stock price target reflects the  
arithmetic mean of the most recently updated, attributable analyst  
price targets I could verify; it is a calculation, not an official  
consensus. With the shares near $13.50, reaching $19 would require a  
gain of roughly 41% — a very large move by any standard. Target, not a  
promise.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/klarna-klar-can-the-stock-recover-toward-the-19-target-after-its-65-slide-40018/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/klarna-klar-can-the-stock-recover-toward-the-19-target-after-its-65-slide-40018/)  
  
\*\*9. Tencent Music Entertainment Group (TME)\*\* — The central $13  
target is the arithmetic mean of the individual analyst price targets  
reviewed, broadly consistent with consensus figures around $12.70 from  
independent data providers. With the stock trading near $8.88,  
reaching $13 would require a move of roughly 46% — a substantial gain  
from current levels. Target, not a promise.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/tencent-music-entertainment-group-tme-path-to-13-target-and-46-upside-potential-39980/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/tencent-music-entertainment-group-tme-path-to-13-target-and-46-upside-potential-39980/)  
  
\*\*10. ZTO Express (ZTO)\*\* — The central target is $27.50 , based on  
the arithmetic mean of analyst price targets for ZTO (ZTO Express  
(Cayman) Inc.), which average roughly $27.49 across 17 analysts  
tracked by S&P Global. The stock recently traded near $20.50 ,  
implying a required gain of about 34% to reach the central target.  
Target, not a promise.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/zto-express-zto-analyst-targets-point-to-34-upside-40010/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/zto-express-zto-analyst-targets-point-to-34-upside-40010/)  
  
\*\*11. Dolby Laboratories (DLB)\*\* — The central stock price target of  
$81 is the arithmetic mean of three verifiable analyst price targets  
($74, $80, and $90), rounded from about $81.33. At a latest verified  
price near $61 , reaching $81 would require a gain of roughly 32% — a  
substantial move, not a marginal one. Target, not a promise.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/dolby-laboratories-dlb-can-shares-reach-the-81-analyst-target-40016/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/dolby-laboratories-dlb-can-shares-reach-the-81-analyst-target-40016/)  
  
\*\*12. Elbit Systems (ESLT)\*\* — The central $870 stock price target is  
the arithmetic mean of four verified analyst price targets, which  
range from $790 to $960. With shares last trading near $706.62,  
reaching $870 would require a move of roughly 23%, a substantial  
advance. Target, not a promise.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/elbit-systems-eslt-stock-is-a-23-move-to-the-870-analyst-target-realistic-39999/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/elbit-systems-eslt-stock-is-a-23-move-to-the-870-analyst-target-realistic-39999/)  
  
\*\*13. BHP (BHP)\*\* — The central target of $87 is the arithmetic mean  
of four current, individually attributable analyst targets ($98, $96,  
$91, and $64). At a recent price near $73.90, reaching $87 implies  
roughly 18% upside, a substantial move. Target, not a promise.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/bhp-group-limited-bhp-analysts-average-87-target-implying-18-upside-40005/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/bhp-group-limited-bhp-analysts-average-87-target-implying-18-upside-40005/)  
  
\*\*14. Disney (DIS)\*\* — The central $135 target is the arithmetic mean  
of nine verified analyst price targets reviewed, spanning roughly $123  
to $144. At a recent price near $117, reaching $135 would require a  
gain of about 15%—a substantial, not trivial, move. Target, not a  
promise.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/disney-dis-analysts-point-to-135-target-suggesting-15-upside-potential-40004/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/disney-dis-analysts-point-to-135-target-suggesting-15-upside-potential-40004/)  
  
\*\*15. Home Depot (HD)\*\* — The central target is $390, the arithmetic  
mean (about $389) of 18 recent, individually verified analyst price  
targets, rounded to a clean level. Shares of The Home Depot, Inc. (HD)  
, the world's largest home improvement retailer, last traded near  
$339, meaning the target implies roughly 15% upside. Target, not a  
promise.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/home-depot-hd-390-analyst-target-suggests-15-upside-potential-40002/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/home-depot-hd-390-analyst-target-suggests-15-upside-potential-40002/)  
  
Which of these targets is actually realistic?  
  
Not financial advice. Figures are from today's (Nov 17) write-ups,  
using intraday or latest-close prices, not live quotes. Price targets  
are targets, not promises.
